finding: Furigana, pinyin and romaja caches previously persisted source sentences and readings under unowned localStorage keys and module-global memory. They are used for private Reader sentences and speaking transcripts as well as public lessons.
changes: Use existing learner-owned account/guest envelopes, separately keyed for three reading formats.
No mutable module-level sentence cache; no unowned-cache hydration/automatic assignment/deletion.
Keep at most80valid sentence entries per format/account; source text must match concatenated segments exactly and satisfy bounded shape/format validation.
Render result only for current owned store and exact text. Ignore cancelled/previous effect responses; use plain text while loading, on invalid response or failure.
meaningfulTests: Production owned-store tests for three added kinds: own reload, guest/B isolation, own restore, stale callbacks and retained original legacy bytes.
Cache shape/format/source validation, retained original input and bounded eviction.
Actual hook with controlled React/store boundaries: sentence changes, delayed earlier replies, actor change, own cached return and disabled requests.
reactReview: No conditional hooks, render-time sentence storage reads or module-level mutable learner data.
Effect cancellation and store/text result identity guard old callbacks and pending render.
limitations: Old unowned cache bytes remain on device as instructed; replacement caches are not learner history and no recovery claim is offered.
No complete app-wide privacy audit claim.
Conjugation registry/user cache, old AI email-capture marker, remaining in-memory/private-context caches still require scoped review.
Hosted isolated Preview remains cfa32b6; accepted companion d4ad837 and live app unchanged.
No schema/role/active-policy/speech-collection/schedule/model calls; durable adaptive runtime and release gates remain open.
